title: Morocco New Adventures.
text:
The experience to Tangier Morocco was amazing, the guide was very knowledgeable, he explained very clear in two different languages, not rushing.
He directed us to the right location for pictures and lunch was delicious , I will recommend this company Viajes de el Sur travel. author: R5944OCgladysc

title: Long, Bur Fun and Worth It
text:
Julian did a great job getting us from Seville to Tarifa. He even offered to help us find a restaurant when we returned late in the evening, which was a thoughtful gesture.

The trip was well worth the long day. Mohammed was informative and entertaining, and the pace kept even our teenager engaged. Vendors will approach you, but a polite, firm "no" was all it took. Overall, a great experience and well worth the time and money.
author: terrij462

title: Great tour with an excellent guide.
text: Excellent guide, Racheed was an excellent tour guide who knew the city in and out and was quite funny. It was definitely a good choice to see Tangier with a tour group, as I would not have been able to experience the crowds and atmosphere the same way we did with the tour guide. The group was large, but it worked out well.  It was a long day, we departed from Seville at 7:00, and arrived back in Seville at 23:00 but it was well worth it. The ferry also was very nice, there is a great cafeteria on board with excellent food. Our experience was awesome. And overall it was worth the price.
author: jonahq2024
